QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Heliseum Reclamation HQ
QuestInfo.0: The operation to reclaim Heliseum has started, but the situation at Reclamation HQ is worse than expected... Get the details from #bBeldar#k in #bPantheon#k.
QuestInfo.1: The situation at the Heliseum Reclamation HQ is worse than expected. It wasn't easy establishing the HQ in the first place, and now it's in danger of collapsing. You must hurry and help them. Go to the #bPantheon portal#k and speak to #bTiron#k.
QuestInfo.2: Tiron has been waiting for someone who could help.

0.0: While you were away, we established the Heliseum Reclamation HQ and set up a plan to reclaim the capital. But Magnus and his army are still very strong. #rWe need to be careful, or we'll lose everything#k...\r\n
0.1: Angelic Buster, I want you to meet our commanders on the Heliseum front, Edea and Piston, and offer your support. Can you do that?

yes.0: Take the stairs to the right and use the portal to #bHeliseum#k. #bTiron#k will be waiting for you with instructions.

no.0: Perhaps you have another idea? If so, tell me.

0.msg: *sob* Who are you? W-wait. You look like... Are you the famous Angelic Buster?!

2.msg: Of course! You're known as the Battleground Idol! You're really famous these days! Wow! Did you also come to help the Heliseum Reclamation HQ? That's a relief!

yes.0: Actually, the Reclamation HQ is in bad shape right now...

npc.0: Take the stairs to the right and use the portal to #bHeliseum#k. #bTiron#k will be waiting for you with instructions.
